description: This file defines the main application structure for an iOS app, including the app delegate, notification handling, background task scheduling, and app initialization using SwiftUI. It manages push notifications, background refreshes, and watch prompt actions.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Handles application lifecycle, push notifications, background tasks, and watch prompt actions for the iOS app.

methods.name: application
methods.description: Initializes app, registers background tasks, and sets notification delegate.

methods.name: didReceiveRemoteNotification
methods.description: Handles incoming remote notifications and triggers background wake if needed.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged
methods.description: Schedules background wake when app enters background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask
methods.description: Registers background refresh task with system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a background wake refresh with delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh
methods.description: Performs background refresh and reschedules itself.

methods.name: isWatchPromptNotification
methods.description: Checks if notification is a watch prompt.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction
methods.description: Parses notification response into a watch prompt action.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction
methods.description: Routes watch prompt action to app model.
